column1: The vending machine's facade wraps four collaborators behind three public methods. In the parking lot project, ParkingFacade wrapped SpotFinder, the pricing factory and TicketManager behind parkVehicle() and unPark(). What is the recurring shape in both?,Both classes exist mainly to reduce the number of imports in Main,"In both, a multi-step sequence with a strict order and a failure path is collapsed into a single call, so the caller cannot perform the steps in the wrong order or skip one",Both classes exist to make the code run faster,Both are required because the underlying classes are in different packages,,2,"The value is the enforced ordering, not the tidier imports. A caller physically cannot dispense before checking change, because there is no way to ask for just that step.",2
